text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The review board's... results have arrived!
It's written in a bunch of tedious, drawn-out words,
but well, in short—this time!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Construction went mostly according to plan,
producing respectable results!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That said, there are areas for improvement!
Building and leveling up facilities fell just one step short of expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This result comes with high hopes
for future growth, wouldn't you say!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
Is the next evaluation meeting in late December?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, I want to be in such tip-top shape that nobody could possibly complain.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!
Stay focused, and just keep pushing forward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 1st Tracen Island Evaluation concluded!
Time to draw up the next construction plan and keep moving forward!
